text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Public administration minister, Ponatshego Kedikilwe, says Botswana will not fund political parties after a proposal to this effect was made at a recent Commonwealth African heads of state meeting.

- Strong criticism in parliament by the Opposition Botswana National Front (BNF) of a motion to set up a 50 million pula fund to aid cash-strapped private contracting companies has forced the government to defer the motion.
- Gazette editor Outsa Mokone has been awarded the second prize in the CNN Africa Journalist of the Year competition.

- The Ministry of Agriculture, investigating possible fraud in the Botswana Agricultural Marketing Board, says it is concerned with the loss of 6.4 percent of the board's grain stock, but has so far found no evidence of wrongdoing.
